info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Behavior Insights API
info.description: The Customer Behavior Insights API enables businesses to analyze and leverage customer interaction data to enhance engagement strategies. This endpoint allows users to submit detailed insights related to customer behavior, facilitating strategic decisions in marketing and product development. Typical consumers include data analysts, marketing teams, and business strategists looking to optimize customer experiences and drive sales. By providing actionable insights, this API supports organizations in understanding customer trends and preferences effectively.

post.description: This endpoint allows developers to submit data related to customer behavior to generate meaningful insights for better understanding and analyzing customer interactions.
